name: L-ORNITHINE / L-ASPARTATE 3 GR GRANULES 10 SACHETS
description: L-Ornithine/L-Aspartate 3g granules in sachets (box of 10) is a medication primarily used to treat liver diseases by reducing elevated levels of ammonia in the blood (hyperammonemia), which can cause hepatic encephalopathy, especially in cases of cirrhosis. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
